Each dish is delicious! Every day I had a different dish in order to discover different tastes of Vietnamese vegetarian and vegan cuisine and I was always surprised by the flavor of each dish. Furthermore, the price-quality ratio is great!

BEST MEAL EVER!!!
Apr 2026 • Friends
I recently tried the Daya Restaurant in Hanoi and really enjoyed it. The food was so good…everything tasted fresh, flavorful, and satisfying, which can sometimes be hard to find with vegetarian options!!!!

The place itself had a cozy, homey vibe that made it easy to relax and enjoy the meal. The staff were extremely friendly and welcoming, and the service was quick without feeling rushed.

Overall, it was a great experience and I’d definitely go back next time I’m in Hanoi!!!!
